entries.225a40f89ade321b: This business provides cloud services that support the connection between beauty and barber salons and their customers. The company group has a single segment in this business, and revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,542 million. The head office is located in Shinagawa-ku, Tokyo, and is tied to this business.
entries.25f2620ffbe27e87: Beauty and barber salons (hair salons, nail salons, beauty salons, relaxation salons, etc.)
entries.77f3e4076c63a91e: A company that provides hair and beauty salons with "BeautyMerit", a cloud-based reservation management system, and "Kanzashi", a unified reservation management system.
entries.c823f83f66d3499f: It is a centralized reservation management system provided by Pacific Porter Co., Ltd., a consolidated subsidiary. It enables centralized management of inventory and pricing across multiple listing sites and the company's own reservation engine, and is linked with POS systems. As of the end of March 2026, it was used by more than 14,000 salons. The amount is not separately disclosed.
